info.title: AgentResolver — Find Missing Agent Tools
info.description: Free read-only fallback discovery for autonomous agents, plus explicitly priced machine-paid capabilities. Resolution never authorizes spending; paid execution requires the calling agent to satisfy the advertised x402 payment challenge under its own spending policy.

tags.name: Agent Tool Discovery
tags.description: Use when an agent is missing a required external capability.

tags.name: Paid Agent Capabilities
tags.description: Optional AgentResolver-owned work protected by an x402 payment challenge. The caller controls whether to spend.

post.summary: Find the missing external capability needed to complete a task
post.description: USE THIS when the current toolset cannot clearly complete the task because an external capability is missing. Describe what the agent needs in goal. AgentResolver returns ranked candidate tools/services. It is free and read-only: this operation does not purchase, authorize, connect to, or execute any returned service. Do not call it when an already-connected trusted tool clearly satisfies the task.

goal.description: Describe the capability required to unblock the task, including important constraints. Example: extract structured data from a JavaScript-heavy product page.

url.description: Optional target URL only when it materially helps capability matching.

missingWebCapability.summary: Agent lacks a suitable web extraction tool

value.goal: Extract structured product data from a JavaScript-heavy webpage
Find an API that can convert a street address into latitude and longitude

200.description: Ranked candidates for the missing capability. Returned services are candidates only; the caller must apply its own trust, privacy, security, and spending policy before use.

post.summary: Audit a public website for AI-agent discoverability
post.description: Paid AgentResolver-owned capability. Price: $0.05 USDC on Base via x402. A request without payment returns HTTP 402 and payment requirements; execution occurs only after the caller independently authorizes and supplies a valid x402 payment. AgentResolver does not authorize spending on the caller's behalf.

target.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS domain or URL to audit.

402.description: x402 payment required. Inspect the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header and retry only if the caller's spending policy authorizes payment.

get.summary: Check AgentResolver availability without running discovery
